purpose: iOS 锁屏实时活动视觉方案选择；生成图片，尚非真实 App 功能验收

variants.title: A-一眼总览
variants.initial_prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / precise-object-edit.
Asset type: a REALISTIC HIGH FIDELITY iPhone iOS lock-screen Live Activity screenshot for Norma OS. This is one single portrait screenshot, not a collage, not a presentation board, no phone hardware or hand.
Input image is the EDIT TARGET. Preserve the attached lock screen: same leafy alley photographic wallpaper, same woman's exact face, body, clothes and pose, same composition, same carrier/status bar, same Chinese date, same large pale green 14:46 clock, same native flashlight and camera controls and home indicator. Keep all pixels outside the bottom activity-card region as unchanged as possible. Do not redesign the wallpaper. Do not add text labels outside the card.
Only replace the existing BLACK card containing Working / 移动多智能体控制 / +11,045 -297 / 160 Files / Norma-AI-OS, with the NEW Live Activity specified below. Erase ALL old card text.
Match the input image's tall portrait aspect ratio ~828x1792. Place card at approximately x=28 to 800, y=1198 to 1518 in the original image coordinate system. Width ~386 iOS logical points; height no more than 160 logical points (~320 pixels); rounded corner radius ~26 points. Card does not overlap woman's face, the clock or bottom flashlight/camera. Native Apple lock-screen margins and visual rhythm, 14pt side padding, excellent Chinese typography in PingFang / SF Pro, visible comfortable type sizes. Clear, meticulously aligned text, restrained SF Symbols style glyphs, absolutely no character avatars, no emoji, no robot illustrations, no decorative charts, no fake logos, no neon glow, no gradients used as text. Chinese text must be precise and readable, exactly as quoted. Keep every letter in Codex / Claude / Gemini / Norma correct.
Product meaning: people should instantly see who is working, actual completed work or phase, and which tasks require their decision or review. Numbers are completed checkpoints or test counts, never a fabricated percentage. Pink indicates needs human attention; mint indicates active/completed, blue indicates an action that opens the app. All state colors also have text labels. This must look like a believable shipping native WidgetKit / ActivityKit Live Activity within the height limit, not a mobile dashboard. No scrolling, tab bar, taskkanban or large sheet inside the card.
VARIANT A — CALM AT-A-GLANCE OVERVIEW.
Card surface near-white pearl with subtly frosted native material, content area mostly opaque for contrast, dark navy #13213D text, tiny mint running dot. Native elegant, very sparse with generous spacing.
Layout:
1. small header "Norma" at left and "移动多 Agent 控制" at right.
2. Large clear primary line "2 个 Agent 正在工作", with small understated running glyph.
3. One single compact identity/status text line "Codex 实现 · Claude 测试 · Gemini 等待". All three visible.
4. Slim mint progress track with four completed segments out of six. Left caption "已完成 4 / 6 项" in readable secondary text.
5. Bottom horizontal row: a pink outlined capsule "1 待决策" and a pink/light-neutral outlined capsule "1 待验收"; small chevron at far right indicating card opens Norma.
No big button. All content fits inside a native ~145–160pt card. Primary hierarchy running count then completed work then human attention. Crisp aligned editorial typography.
variants.final_edit_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / ui-mockup.
Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: a generated Norma iOS lock-screen prototype. Image 2 is the original underlying wallpaper/reference screenshot, to restore wallpaper where the old larger card disappears.
Change only one thing: make Image 1's Live Activity card physically SHORTER with compact native layout, keeping the complete correct existing card Chinese text, Latin agent names, exact counts, surface color, hierarchy, glyphs, overall style and button intent. Preserve ALL lock screen content outside the resized card including exact woman face/pose/wallpaper, status, date/time, flashlight/camera/home indicator.
CRITICAL geometry, in output screenshot coordinates: keep the same full portrait image aspect ratio and resolution. Outer card left x=3.6% of full image width, right x=96.4%; TOP y=68.1% of full image height; BOTTOM y=84.3% of full image height. The card must fit fully inside this explicit rectangle, no taller than 16.2% of full screenshot height. At the reference iPhone's logical width this is approximately 145pt tall, within iOS Live Activity's 160pt maximum. Bottom flashlight/camera must remain at their existing place below y=86.7% and there must be a clean wallpaper gap between card and those controls. Restore any exposed wallpaper by referencing Image 2. Do not simply move the controls down or crop the screenshot.
Reflow content compactly with 12–14pt inset, native crisp PingFang / SF Pro type; small labels 12–13pt and readable normal text 14–15pt, headline 17–18pt. Tighten unnecessary vertical gaps and row heights, avoid oversized heading. Preserve three named agents and every pending-decision and pending-review indicator. If present the single blue action retains a 40–44pt comfortable height. Preserve all numerals EXACTLY. No percentage invented, no new badges, no phone frame, no altered wallpaper, no missing content, no new words, no collage.
Variant identity: A A-一眼总览. This is a targeted geometric repair of an already finished design, not a fresh alternative.
